WONDER DAILY AGE 8 · GRADE 3 · ANSWERS · 3 / 3

Four looks at a hand

How a Hand Works

Quiz 1. What keeps a finger stiff?
Small bones in a row keep each finger firm.
Quiz 2. What pulls a finger closed?
A forearm muscle pulls a tendon, and the tendon pulls the finger bones.
Quiz 3. Where does a finger bend?
A finger bends at joints, where two bones meet.
Quiz 4. What opens a hand again?
Muscles only pull, so tendons on the back of the hand pull fingers straight.
Gentle pulls only: no yanking strings or bending fingers backward. Toys differ; a paper-and-straw hand works too.
